name: Shanghai Pudong Construction Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Pudong Construction Co.,Ltd. engages in the construction business in China. It operates through six segments: Construction Design, Surveying, and Consulting Services; Production and Sales of Building Materials; Integrated Industrial Park Development; Factoring Business, and Others. The company undertakes construction of municipal highway, rail transit, water conservancy, interior decoration, and foundation projects.
